caption: The drawing depicts two images of the same puppet figure on a plain beige background. The larger, central figure is a puppet with exaggerated facial features, including wide eyes, a broad mouth showing teeth, and a prominent nose. The puppet's face is mostly pink and red with dark, thick eyebrows. It wears a blue hat with light blue and yellow details and a red headband. Its outfit consists of a long green coat with yellow trim, a red collar, and a checkered shirt underneath, with brown pants and shoes. The puppet's hands and head are disproportionately large compared to its body. To the upper left, there is a smaller side-view drawing of the puppet’s head and torso, showing the same blue hat and facial features, with part of the green coat’s collar visible. The drawing is signed "W.P.A William L. Rowley" in the lower right corner.
title: Hand Puppet "Punch"
